findings.passage: “The California Voter ID initiative is a common sense and bipartisan way to restore the trust and confidence all voters should have in our election system,” Tangipa said. “Our measure simply holds government officials accountable to maintain accurate voter lists and verify the identity of individuals casting ballots in our elections.”
findings.note: Quoted by the San Joaquin Valley Sun at a Fresno rally announcing submission of the California Voter ID ballot measure.

findings.passage: Tangipa continued, “We think this (proposed CA ballot initiative) brings us up to a modern level of security.”
findings.note: Quoted by myMotherLode (published 2025-07-18) from a radio interview on the proposed voter ID ballot measure; the same story reports he compared California with voter ID rules in Mexico, Canada and the European Union, and describes the measure as requiring proof of citizenship checks at registration, ID at the polls, and the last four digits of an ID for mail voters.

findings.passage: It is going from a voter ID and citizenship verification constitutional amendment to now say prohibits citizens from voting," says Tangipa. "This is insane. The highest law enforcement officer is now actively rigging the election in the middle of the election season.”
findings.note: KALW/CapRadio report quoting him on the Attorney General's changed ballot title for the November 2026 voter ID and citizenship verification initiative.
